title: Daytime Dehazing Density Consistency CARL Multiseed Numerical Stability v1
rationale: The receipt-bound rerun reached 24 of 41 units and ended FAILED_ENGINEERING at the frozen three-seed summary because at least one raw grouped contrast was non-finite. Its archived closeout SHA-256 is 2c3b36264e14288dcc905716fd0922dccb4eb2a5eb14c947636425335e0625b6, with decision null, authorizes=NONE, scientific-data touch, and no protected-data touch. The closeout does not identify the first non-finite tensor, seed, arm, or scene, so this contract makes no such claim and never reads partial scientific results. The user-authorized formal amendment changes one operational fixed factor: CUDA TF32 moves from unspecified framework-default behavior to explicit disablement for matmul and cuDNN. The route adds observation-only fail-fast finite assertions over prediction, component and total loss, gradient, parameter, optimizer, EMA teacher, evaluation prediction, and PSNR state. The protected-data-free engineering contract exercises the first frozen seed through all four arms for 1000 steps each, totaling 4000 representative synthetic iterations under the fixed 900-second limit, before scientific work is eligible. Every scientific cell retains its full 2000-step trajectory through the same asserted code. The scientific 2x2 intervention, five frozen seed blocks, data roles, optimizer, learning rate, budgets, losses and weights, metrics, thresholds, uncertainty, sequential boundaries, and 41-unit ledger remain unchanged. No non-finite value may be filtered, imputed, clipped, replaced, or excluded. This route tests one falsifiable stability repair and cannot establish the cause if another non-finite failure occurs. Development evidence cannot authorize confirmation, sealed-final access, promotion, deployment, publication, or another repair route.

orthogonal_changes.reason: The unchanged multiseed precision route cannot reach a scientific terminal until the archived non-finite training outcome is addressed. This evidence-bound route preserves the raw estimands and seed-blocking model while changing only the amended CUDA TF32 fixed factor and adding observation-only finite assertions.

scientific_contract.question: With CUDA TF32 explicitly disabled and fail-fast finite diagnostics applied without changing the frozen intervention, is the official ConvIR-B 2x2 CARL-by-density-consistency route numerically finite through all five seed blocks, and if so is the raw combined-versus-baseline scene PSNR effect material and directionally stable while the two main effects and interaction remain separable under one simultaneous comparison family?

primary_estimand.aggregation: Within each seed and original-clear scene, average the four haze-observation PSNR values for each arm and compute the raw finite b11_combined minus b00_baseline difference without clipping or winsorization. At each predeclared look, average the completed paired-seed differences within scene, then report the scene mean, the five seed-specific scene means, and the three fixed density-stratum scene means. Seeds are frozen paired blocks and never increase the independent scene count.

gates.reference: Exact route, code, checkpoint, VGG asset, role ledger, arm, seed, grouping, look, gate, explicit CUDA TF32 disablement, and finite-assertion identities must match the generated contract.

The SHA-bound ledger must cover exactly twenty training cells, twenty seed-by-arm evaluation bundles that each retain all 150 development scenes, and one terminal summary. Units skipped only by the frozen three-seed futility rule remain explicit typed skipped outputs, so every valid terminal covers exactly 41 units.

Every fixed density-stratum raw combined-effect interval must have half-width at most 0.260 dB at the final look; actual observed uncertainty, not the transferred planning bound, determines this gate.

At the terminal look, the simultaneous lower bound of the raw seed-blocked b11-minus-b00 scene effect must exceed the unchanged +0.10 dB minimum meaningful effect. At the three-seed look, an upper bound at or below +0.10 dB triggers nonbinding futility and a scientific FAIL.

At the terminal five-seed look, every seed-specific raw combined-effect simultaneous interval must have a lower bound above 0.0 dB for stable direction. At either look, any completed seed-specific upper bound at or below 0.0 dB is unstable; otherwise the gate is indeterminate.

At the terminal look, each of the CARL main effect, consistency main effect, and interaction must be classified by its simultaneous interval as materially positive above +0.05 dB, materially negative below -0.05 dB, or equivalent-to-small wholly inside [-0.05,+0.05] dB. Any crossing interval leaves mechanism attribution unresolved.

The route is safe only when every fixed density-stratum simultaneous lower bound for the raw seed-blocked b11-minus-b00 effect is at least -0.10 dB. It is unsafe when any stratum upper bound is below -0.10 dB; otherwise it is indeterminate.

scientific_contract.competing_explanation: The r4 clipped PASS may reflect a single favorable training seed, clipping-induced loss of rank information, or a combined objective whose apparent components cannot be separated. The paired five-seed 2x2 design, raw finite scene contrasts, seed-specific intervals, exact equal budgets, unchanged VGG identity, fixed density strata, simultaneous comparison family, nonbinding futility rule, and generic unit ledger distinguish these explanations without changing the intervention or accessing protected data.

research_update_binding.bottleneck_statement: The multiseed scientific question remains unresolved because the fresh rerun produced at least one non-finite raw grouped contrast after completing 24 of 41 units. The archived closeout does not identify the first non-finite seed, arm, scene, loss, gradient, parameter, optimizer state, EMA state, or prediction, so one explicit numerical fixed factor and fail-fast observation path must be tested before another scientific interpretation is possible.

literature_basis.task: explicit CUDA TF32 backend control for float32 matmul and cuDNN operations
literature_basis.transferable_claim: PyTorch exposes separate matmul and cuDNN controls that can explicitly disable TF32 execution on Ampere-class and later CUDA devices.
literature_basis.applicability_limit: The framework documentation does not establish that TF32 caused this route's non-finite value or that disabling it will make ConvIR-B training finite; that claim is tested by the frozen full-path diagnostic.

literature_basis.task: contrast-assisted reconstruction and haze-density consistency training losses
literature_basis.transferable_claim: A component factorial can separate reconstruction contrast loss, haze-density consistency, and their combination in a dehazing training objective.
literature_basis.applicability_limit: The published FFA-Net/RESIDE K=5 results do not predict ConvIR-B/Haze4K effect sizes, seed stability, thresholds, or PASS criteria; this route preserves the prior K=4 transfer.

literature_basis.task: variance accounting in machine-learning benchmark comparisons
literature_basis.transferable_claim: Training randomness and data-sampling variability can materially change benchmark comparisons and should be represented in experimental design.
literature_basis.applicability_limit: The paper does not determine this route's seed count, PSNR threshold, Haze4K variance, or scientific outcome.

literature_basis.task: influence of random seeds in computer-vision deep learning
literature_basis.transferable_claim: A single seed can be atypically favorable or unfavorable, motivating predeclared repeated seeds and score distributions.
literature_basis.applicability_limit: The paper does not establish that five seeds exhaust the training-seed distribution or validate any dehazing mechanism.

literature_basis.task: reporting score distributions across repeated neural-network runs
literature_basis.transferable_claim: Distributional reporting across repeated runs is more informative than one point estimate.
literature_basis.applicability_limit: The sequence-tagging results do not transfer numerically to image restoration and provide no dehazing threshold.

hypotheses.statement: Explicitly disabling CUDA TF32 while preserving all scientific factors is sufficient for every frozen seed-by-arm trajectory, evaluation prediction, PSNR value, and raw grouped contrast to remain finite.
hypotheses.discriminating_prediction: The protected-data-free 4000-iteration representative four-arm diagnostic and the subsequent full 2000-step scientific cells complete with every declared finite assertion passing.
hypotheses.falsifier: Any declared prediction, component or total loss, gradient, parameter, optimizer tensor, EMA teacher tensor, evaluation prediction, PSNR value, or grouped contrast becomes non-finite under explicit TF32 disablement.

hypotheses.statement: The raw combined CARL-plus-consistency utility is material and directionally stable across the five frozen paired seed blocks.
hypotheses.discriminating_prediction: The terminal raw seed-blocked combined-effect lower bound exceeds +0.10 dB and every seed-specific lower bound exceeds 0.0 dB.
hypotheses.falsifier: The combined-effect upper bound is at or below +0.10 dB, or any seed-specific upper bound is at or below 0.0 dB.

hypotheses.statement: CARL has a separable raw main effect under the balanced factorial rather than appearing positive only because of the prior clipping boundary.
hypotheses.discriminating_prediction: The raw CARL main-effect simultaneous interval is materially positive, materially negative, or wholly equivalent-to-small within +/-0.05 dB.
hypotheses.falsifier: The terminal raw CARL main-effect interval crosses both the equivalence and materiality regions.

hypotheses.statement: Haze-density consistency has a separable raw main effect under the balanced factorial.
hypotheses.discriminating_prediction: The raw consistency main-effect simultaneous interval is materially positive, materially negative, or wholly equivalent-to-small within +/-0.05 dB.
hypotheses.falsifier: The terminal raw consistency main-effect interval crosses both the equivalence and materiality regions.

hypotheses.statement: The raw CARL-by-consistency interaction is identifiable as synergistic, antagonistic, or equivalent-to-small.
hypotheses.discriminating_prediction: The raw interaction interval lies wholly above +0.05 dB, wholly below -0.05 dB, or wholly inside [-0.05,+0.05] dB.
hypotheses.falsifier: The terminal raw interaction interval crosses both the equivalence and materiality regions.

design_selection.decision_value: One route first falsifies or supports the single explicit-TF32 numerical repair on a protected-data-free representative 1000-step trajectory through all four arm branches, then, only if finite, preserves the original full 2000-step shared seed-blocked 2x2 decision on raw utility and factorial attribution.
design_selection.expected_time_to_decision: A non-finite engineering tensor stops before scientific-data access with its stage, seed, arm, step, and tensor class identified. If the full engineering map is finite, the unchanged predeclared nonbinding futility look after three scientific seed blocks can stop a non-material or directionally failed replication; otherwise the terminal five-seed look resolves the frozen decision table.
design_selection.shared_setup: All engineering and scientific cells share the official ConvIR-B architecture, checkpoint, per-arm optimizer and 2000-step budget, batch shape, VGG identity, losses, explicit TF32 disablement, finite assertions, and inference implementation; scientific cells additionally use only the unchanged Haze4K roles, evaluation roster, and density strata.
design_selection.worst_case_stopping_cost: The protected-data-free qualification executes 4000 synthetic iterations, the first frozen seed through all four arm branches for 1000 steps each, under the 900-second engineering limit and a 14400-second mechanical bound for the unchanged 40000-iteration scientific map. If it passes, scientific execution then costs either twelve 2000-step cells plus twelve seed-by-arm evaluation bundles and sixteen explicit skipped units after the three-seed futility boundary, or all twenty training cells and twenty seed-by-arm evaluation bundles. The first non-finite assertion stops the affected phase without filtering or retry.

decision_design.multiplicity_control: The terminal family contains twelve simultaneous two-sided Bonferroni comparisons: the combined primary, CARL main effect, consistency main effect, interaction, three density-stratum combined effects, and five seed-specific combined effects. Only the first three seed-specific comparisons are observed at the nonbinding futility look, but the frozen terminal-family critical value 2.865 is conservatively used at both looks. The three-seed look cannot produce efficacy PASS and therefore spends no efficacy alpha.

boundaries.success: No early efficacy terminal is permitted. PASS is available only after all five seed blocks, exact ledger coverage, and every decisive gate passes.
boundaries.futility: After three complete seed blocks, stop and write all remaining seed units as typed skipped outputs when the combined raw upper bound is at or below +0.10 dB or any completed seed-specific raw upper bound is at or below 0.0 dB.
boundaries.precision: At the terminal five-seed look, any fixed density-stratum half-width above 0.260 dB is inconclusive-only and cannot hide a decisive combined, seed, or safety FAIL.
boundaries.validity: Any route, asset, data-role, grouping, arm, seed, look, protected-access, output, or exact completed-unit-ledger failure triggers the validity veto.

precision_contract.rationale: The raw primary and fixed density-stratum contrasts require a pre-run planning-SD transfer bound and actual terminal uncertainty. The largest archived RESIDE development upper bound is transferred conservatively with explicit cross-dataset limitations.

capability.production_path_statement: The protected-data-free qualification explicitly disables CUDA TF32 and executes the first frozen seed through every arm-specific model, teacher, optimizer, CARL, consistency, and finite-assertion production branch for 1000 steps each, exactly 4000 representative CUDA iterations. The unchanged scientific map remains exactly 40000 fixed iterations across all five seeds with 2000 steps per cell. Batch shape and memory scaling are fixed, there is no candidate schedule or adaptive termination, and the qualification reads no Haze4K image or role outcome, trains no scientific weight, and creates no scientific result. Any non-finite value fails immediately without replacement or omission.

assurance.planning_sd_rule: Use 0.632364322219979 dB, the larger archived 1.05-multiplied planning-SD upper bound from 1587-scene development-only RESIDE ITS/OTS continuous-utility evidence. This is a conservative feasibility transfer, not an observed Haze4K variance or a guarantee; actual Haze4K raw intervals own the inconclusive-only precision gate.
